estimates.assumptions: 5 large potatoes ≈ 1.25 kg total raw weight; standard russet-type values (22 g carbs, 2.8 g fiber per 100 g raw)
2 tbs olive oil = 28 g; pure fat, zero carbs/fiber
1 large green pepper ≈ 150 g raw edible portion after deseeding (6 g carbs, 2 g fiber per 100 g)
5 medium onions ≈ 750 g total raw peeled weight (11 g carbs, 2 g fiber per 100 g)
1 tbs Ras el hanout ≈ 6 g; typical spice blend values
500 g raw pumpkin, peeled and cubed; edible flesh only (13 g carbs, 1.4 g fiber per 100 g)
24 large eggs (≈ 50 g edible each after shelling); ≈0.25 g carbs per egg, negligible fiber
Pinch of salt; negligible contribution, cannot reasonably quantify
Pinch of pepper; negligible contribution, cannot reasonably quantify
